annotations.title: Income tax: old vs new regime

description: Income tax for FY 2026-27 (tax year 2026-27) under the new and old regimes for a salaried resident individual below 60, including the standard deduction, rebate, marginal relief, surcharge and 4% cess. Starts from salary: the HRA exemption is worked out from basic pay, HRA received and rent. Old-regime deductions (HRA, 80C, 80D, own NPS 80CCD(1B), home loan interest) are optional inputs; employer NPS counts in both regimes (up to 14% of basic in the new regime, 10% in the old). Taxable income and total tax are rounded to the nearest Rs 10 (Income-tax Act, 2025, s.516).

basic_monthly.description: Basic + DA a month in rupees (default: half of gross / 12). Used for HRA and the employer NPS limit

deduction_80c.description: Section 80C investments in rupees, including employee EPF (old regime only, default 0)

deduction_80d.description: Section 80D health insurance premium in rupees (old regime only, default 0)

employer_nps.description: Employer NPS contribution for the year in rupees (both regimes, default 0)

gross_annual_income.description: Gross salary for the year in rupees, including HRA, bonus and employer NPS

home_loan_interest.description: Interest on a self-occupied home loan for the year in rupees (old regime only, default 0)

hra_received_monthly.description: HRA received a month in rupees (default 0)

lives_in_50_percent_city.description: Lives in Mumbai, Delhi, Kolkata, Chennai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune or Ahmedabad (default true)

own_nps_80ccd1b.description: Own NPS contribution under 80CCD(1B), in rupees (old regime only, default 0)

rent_monthly.description: Rent paid a month in rupees (default 0)
